_note: Curated companion to gen-contracts.mjs. Holds only the facts that are NOT statically derivable from web/src: event detail TYPES, gotchas, a11y notes, canonical examples, `since` versions, and token roles. Mechanical facts (attributes, event names, methods, slots, consumed CSS vars, API signatures) are extracted from source and must not be duplicated here.

druid-popover.summary: Anchored panel primitive: hangs arbitrary content off a trigger in the top layer, with light-dismiss and same-trigger toggle.

slots.trigger: The anchor element; clicking it toggles the panel.

css_vars.--df-accent: panel border color (override for a quiet-at-rest / accent-when-open trigger)

druid-popover.a11y: Panel is role=dialog; light-dismiss on outside-click and Esc (scroll never dismisses); same-trigger click toggles.
gotchas: placement splits on '-': base edge (top|bottom|left|right) + align (start|end). bottom-start aligns the panel's LEFT edge to the trigger; bottom-end aligns its RIGHT edge. Bare 'left'/'right' default to -start.
Panel is position:fixed in the top layer (native popover), so it escapes overflow/scroll clipping.
Tracks the trigger on scroll and resize (capture-phase scroll listener catches inner scroll containers too); it repositions rather than dismissing.

It aligns to the border-box of whatever you put in slot=trigger. A druid-button's inner <button> sizes to its content and won't fill a forced-wider host width, so give the trigger its natural size or the alignment will look offset.
Flips to the opposite side when short on viewport space, then clamps into the viewport.

druid-tooltip.summary: Themed hover/focus bubble that wraps the element it describes; works over disabled controls where native title is unreliable.

slots.default: The element being described (the hover/focus target).

druid-tooltip.a11y: Bubble is role=tooltip; shows on hover and focus-within, Esc hides it.
druid-tooltip.example:
<druid-tooltip text="Locked while a model is pinned">
  <druid-textarea disabled></druid-textarea>
</druid-tooltip>
gotchas: Empty or cleared `text` hides the bubble entirely — drive a conditional tooltip by setting/clearing `text` (or set `disabled`).
Bubble renders in the top layer, so scroll/overflow ancestors never clip it; it flips to stay on-screen.
Because the wrapper owns the hover, it fires over a disabled child control (unlike native title).

attribute_notes.variant: soft / soft-danger added in 1.0.2; outline added in 1.0.3. outline = --df-select-bg background + --df-accent border.
attribute_notes.loading: shows a spinner and makes the control inert (clicks and submits are dropped); combine with your own request handling.

css_vars.--df-accent: primary fill, active/hover border, soft text

druid-button.a11y: aria-pressed reflects `active` when `toggle` is set; type=submit forwards to the closest light-DOM form.
gotchas: variant=outline is the dropdown-trigger look: --df-select-bg background with a --df-accent border at rest.
Recolor any variant with a df-ok / df-warn / df-danger class, which repoint --df-accent / --df-accent-soft.
The inner <button> sizes to its content; a forced width on the host does not stretch it.
loading does not disable the underlying button element — it suppresses the click in JS — so a form still sees the control, it just cannot be re-submitted.

slots.default: Inline <svg> to render when `icon` is not set.

druid-icon-button.a11y: Set `label` for the aria-label; renders as an <a> when `href` is set.
druid-icon-button.example:
<druid-icon-button icon="pencil" label="Edit" toggle></druid-icon-button>
<druid-icon-button variant="soft" class="df-warn" icon="upload" label="Unload"></druid-icon-button>
gotchas: Prefer `icon="name"` (a registered icon) over slotting an <svg>; the icon must be registered first via druids.registerIcons.
soft / soft-danger mirror druid-button: colored wash at rest, border on hover; pair soft with a df-* class to retint.
loading does not disable the underlying button element — it suppresses the click in JS — so a form still sees the control, it just cannot be re-submitted.

attribute_notes.loading: shows a spinner and makes the control inert (clicks and submits are dropped); combine with your own request handling.

slots.default: Light-DOM <option> children (read and watched; JS-populated selects work).

druid-select.a11y: Trigger is aria-haspopup=listbox with aria-expanded; menu is role=listbox, items role=option.
druid-select.example:
<druid-select name="model" placeholder="Choose model">
  <option value="a">Model A</option>
  <option value="b">Model B</option>
</druid-select>
gotchas: Set `name` to get a hidden light-DOM input so classic form POSTs carry the value.
Options are declared as <option> children, never rendered directly; they are watched via MutationObserver.

druid-tabs.a11y: Document-level tab strip; you own the .df-tab-panel[data-tab-panel] sections and toggle .active.
gotchas: The strip scrolls horizontally inside itself when the tabs do not fit, so it never widens the page on a narrow viewport — in the navbar or placed in content alike.
druid-tabs.example:
<druid-tabs active="home">
  <druid-tab panel="home">Home</druid-tab>
  <druid-tab panel="logs">Logs</druid-tab>
</druid-tabs>
<section class="df-tab-panel active" data-tab-panel="home">…</section>

druid-subtabs.example:
Models
…
gotchas: Scoped to itself (unlike druid-tabs), so it nests inside a page tab.
Emits its own subtab-change plus a bubbling tab-change so visibility-aware children (druid-log-view) pause/resume.
Light-DOM input; fires `search` with the current value while typing, debounced by `debounce` ms.

druid-log-view.a11y: Self-polling log table; polls only while visible.
gotchas: src returns JSON: a bare array or {entries:[...]} of {time,level,source,message} or {raw}.
poll is in seconds (0 = off); boxed paints a raised header over a base-shade body (--df-panel-header-bg / --df-panel-body-bg).

druid-chat-message.example:
<druid-chat-message sender="assistant" label="llama3">
  Hi there
  <druid-icon-button slot="actions" circle small icon="copy" label="Copy"></druid-icon-button>
</druid-chat-message>
gotchas: User bubbles (sender=user) auto-tint slotted icon-buttons to the accent.
Light DOM, so it posts in normal forms and autofills. maxlength -1 = no limit; autosize grows to content.
The framework ships NO icons; register them once with druids.registerIcons({name: svg}). Unknown names render nothing.
Inherits currentColor and sizes in em; set `size` for a one-off.
indeterminate (boolean) animates an accent bar with no value.
Usually rendered by base.jinja2 from the Druids object; brand + logout-href attributes.
No attributes; place in the navbar actions slot. Drives druids.applyAccent / rainbow.
Rendered by base.jinja2; brand, version, author, github attributes.
Light-DOM, form-participating login form rendered by the framework login page; brand, action, error, subtitle.
A pill inside druid-tabs (panel + reflected active) or slot=tab inside druid-subtabs.

druid-table.summary: Sorting and live filtering for a plain light-DOM table (slotted, never rebuilt).

table-sort.key: string — the sorted column's data-key, else its header text

attribute_notes.sort: column key to sort by: a <th>'s data-key, else its trimmed header text.
attribute_notes.filter: the active query; set it from the app to filter without the built-in box.

css_vars.--df-panel-header-bg: header bar of the boxed table

druid-table.a11y: Sorted headers carry aria-sort=ascending|descending; the filter input is labelled from search-placeholder.
druid-table.example:
NameSizeActions
gemma8.1 GBrun
gotchas: The table is slotted light DOM: style it with .df-table and render its rows server-side as usual. The component only reorders <tr> nodes and toggles their hidden flag.
Sorting compares a cell's data-value when present, else its text; two values that both parse as numbers compare numerically. Use data-value for anything formatted ("8.1 GB", a date).
<th data-sort="none"> opts a column out of sorting (action columns).
Rows added or replaced later are picked up automatically by a MutationObserver; call refresh() only if you mutate rows in a way that does not touch the DOM.
Sticky headers and the scroll container come from .df-table / .df-table-wrap in druids.css, not from this component.

A .df-table is width:100%, so it can never outgrow the scroll container and a narrow viewport squeezes the columns. Add class "wide" to the table (or tune --df-table-min-width) to give it a width floor and get horizontal scrolling; tables with 5+ columns get that floor automatically under 720px.

The scroll container only engages if the table's ancestors can shrink: give any grid track minmax(0, ...) and any flex/grid item min-width: 0, otherwise the ancestor grows to the table's floor and the page gets the horizontal scrollbar instead. Applies to the automatic 5+-column floor too, which needs no opt-in.

confirm.summary: Promise-returning yes/no modal on the .df-dialog chrome. Resolves false on cancel or dismiss.
confirm.example: druids.confirm("Delete this model?", { danger: true }).then(ok => { if (ok) … });

prompt.summary: Promise-returning text-input modal. Resolves the string on OK, or null on cancel/dismiss.
prompt.example: druids.prompt("Pin as:", { value: current }).then(name => { if (name !== null) … });

modal.summary: Open a modal with arbitrary content on the .df-dialog chrome (backdrop / Esc / focus-trap); returns the <dialog>, already open.
modal.example: druids.modal({ title: "Repo quants", content: node, actions: [{ label: "Close" }] });

registerIcon.summary: Register one icon by name for <druid-icon> / icon=.

registerIcons.summary: Register a map of {name: svgString} for <druid-icon> / icon=.

applyAccent.summary: Set the app accent color (hex); persisted per app.

ACCENTS.summary: Array of preset accent hex values (the palette).

surfaces.--bg-dim: sunken well: input, table and log surfaces cut into the page
surfaces.--bg-header: header bar of a raised thing (card, panel, table head) — the lightest resting shade
surfaces.--bg-hover: hover-state fill (transient only, never a resting surface)
surfaces.--df-panel-header-bg: header bar override (.df-card, druid-log-view, druid-subtabs, druid-table)

lines_text.--border-strong: edges that must read as edges (table rules, sticky header underline)

accent.--df-accent: component accent override (defaults to --accent; df-* classes repoint it)

shape.--df-table-min-width: width floor of a .df-table.wide, and of any table with 5+ columns under 720px, so the wrap scrolls horizontally instead of squeezing (defaults to 620px)
shape.--radius-sm: tighter radius for dense chrome (inputs, cells, chips)

focus.--focus-ring: box-shadow halo applied on :focus-visible across light and shadow DOM
focus.--glow: the same halo as a resting glow for lit elements

motion.--df-ease: shared easing curve — quick out, unhurried settle
motion.--df-empty-mark: brand leaf as a CSS mask url, published by theme.ts for .df-empty
